Vicar of St.

Mary’s Oxford

A prominent Tractarian, pupil of the Rt.

Rev.

George Moberly, a celibate, brother of the Rev.

John Marriott, Vicar of St.

John’s Hythe. [ODNB; according to Moor, Erminois]
